name: Racing
summary:
Racing

Racing combines first-person racing, romance, and character development. Drive high-speed cars, compete against other racers, and share every journey with your customizable companion as you chase your racing dreams.

First-Person Racing
Experience every corner from the driver's seat. Master each track, activate unique engine skills, overtake your rivals, and push beyond your limits to reach the podium.

Multiplayer Racing
Create a custom room or join other players in races for up to five competitors
